title: 第二十二章   吃亏与占便宜
content_zh:
一路上，前方的少年狂奔着，羞怒的声音从身后的少女口中传出：“色胚，你还跑，停下来！”

    “慢！”停下来的琼霄，望着冲来的蓝湘开口道。

    “色胚！赶紧给我死来！”面色通红的蓝湘紧盯着琼霄道。

    “额，你又打不过我！要不我们都不用自身星力，就这样打一场？你要是胜的了我，我任由学姐处置！怎样？”琼霄咧咧嘴说道。

    “行，星力上，我打不过你，我就不信不使用自身星力，你还能打的过我？”蓝湘气冲冲的说道。

    “嘿嘿，小样，还不是上当了？看我怎么虐你？”琼霄暗暗道。

    咻！蓝湘身形一闪，极速朝着琼霄而来，一掌朝着琼霄脸庞扇了过来。

    好快！没想到不使用星力，蓝湘速度也有这么快，避之不及，琼霄反手一掌朝着蓝湘小脸拍去。

    就这样两只手停留在了离各自脸前不远处。

    两只各自手突然退了回来，紧接着，蓝湘左脚以迅雷不及掩耳之势朝着琼霄膝盖踢去，同样琼霄右脚朝着蓝湘踢去。

    砰！

    两人同时倒退而出，踉跄站定，“琼霄你好狠的心啊！”蓝湘俏脸气的发白。

    “呵呵，彼此彼此，你也不是什么善茬。”琼霄谈谈的笑了笑。

    前面与琼霄的交锋中，自己输了，这是极度羞辱的一件事情。

    这个面子，一定要挽回来！

    非挽回不可！

    在蓝湘身形出动的一瞬间，琼霄的身形也同时而出。

    两道人影已经纠缠在了一起，噗噗的轻响连成一片，谁也不知道短短数息之间这两人究竟出了多少招式！

    随着时间流逝，两人越战越猛，两道身形的速度愈来愈快，如同两股小型的龙卷风纠缠在一起，最后分不清到底谁是谁！

    蓝湘越打越郁闷，这琼霄实在太阴狠了，每一招每一式，这家伙所有的攻击没有离开过致命之处，虽然都被自己躲过了，但他总能在第一时间进行反扑。

    最让人无语的是他完全没有因为蓝湘是女子而有一点什么觉悟，只是不停的攻击，眼睛，喉咙，皆是他的攻击之处，总而言之，那里致命，他就攻击哪里，让人防不胜防！

    “琼霄你居然不懂的怜香惜玉，出招如此狠毒！”蓝湘喝道。

    “嘿嘿，学姐，在生死搏斗中，谁管男女之别啊，只有生死之分！”琼霄戏谑道。

    “你，你，你！真是气死我了！这是切磋！你用的着生死相搏吗？”

    “好好，那就切磋切磋！”

    其实，不只蓝湘难受，琼霄也暗暗叫苦，这蓝湘的灵敏度实在恐怖，面对着琼霄的攻击，都几乎能闪躲过去，而且蓝湘的打法也有些无赖，琼霄的裤裆，鼻子，眼睛，蓝湘都有照顾到，这使得琼霄有些叫苦不迭。

    搏战了，半天，也没有分出胜负，蓝湘与琼霄都在叫苦。“既然如此，那就赌一把了！”蓝湘暗暗道。

    随着琼霄一拳上来，按照武学常理来说，这一拳，毫无疑问蓝湘是要躲避的，可蓝湘突然间仿佛吓呆了一般，没有丝毫闪避的意图，突然停下来，放下了抵御，小脸直直朝着琼霄拳头而来。琼霄吓了一跳，眼看着拳头就要打到蓝湘脸上，这要是一拳打上去，蓝湘那漂亮的脸蛋就要毁容了！紧急时刻，琼霄拳锋一转从蓝湘脸旁而过。

    “好险！”琼霄心里暗自幸庆，正想问蓝湘到底怎么回事，为什么突然间停手？可话还没出口，脸上却挨了重重一拳，顿时踉跄后退了几步。
content_en:
Along the way, the young man in front ran wildly, and a shy and angry voice came from the mouth of the girl behind him: "Slut, you're still running, stop!"

"Slow down!" Qiong Xiao stopped and looked at Lan Xiang who was rushing towards him and said.

"Sex embryo! Come and die!" Lan Xiang, whose face was red, stared at Qiong Xiao and said.

"Well, you can't beat me! How about we just fight like this without using our own star power? If you can defeat me, I will let the senior sister handle it! What?" Qiong Xiao said with a grin.

"Okay, in terms of star power, I can't beat you. I don't believe you can beat me without using your own star power?" Lan Xiang said angrily.

"Hey, little guy, haven't you been fooled yet? See how I torture you?" Qiong Xiao secretly said.

call out!Lan Xiang's body flashed, and he came towards Qiong Xiao at high speed, and slapped Qiong Xiao in the face with his palm.

So fast!Unexpectedly, Lan Xiang could be so fast without using star power. Unable to avoid him, Qiong Xiao slapped Lan Xiang's face with his backhand.

In this way, the two hands stayed not far from their respective faces.

The two hands suddenly retreated, and then, Lan Xiang's left foot kicked towards Qiong Xiao's knee with lightning speed, and Qiong Xiao's right foot also kicked towards Lan Xiang.

Bang!

The two of them stepped back at the same time and stood up staggeringly, "Qiong Xiao, you are so cruel!" Lan Xiang's pretty face turned pale with anger.

"Haha, you and I are not good at each other." Qiong Xiao smiled casually.

In the previous confrontation with Qiong Xiao, he lost, which was extremely humiliating.

This face must be saved!

It must be redeemed!

The moment Lan Xiang's figure emerged, Qiong Xiao's figure also appeared at the same time.

The two figures were entangled together, and there were soft popping sounds. No one knew how many moves these two people had performed in just a few breaths!

As time passed, the fight between the two became more and more fierce. The speed of the two figures became faster and faster, like two small tornadoes entangled together. In the end, it was impossible to tell who was who!

The more Lan Xiang fought, the more depressed he became. This Qiong Xiao was so ruthless. Every move, every move, all of this guy's attacks never left the fatal point. Although he had dodged them all, he could always counterattack as soon as possible.

The most speechless thing is that he has no consciousness at all because Lan Xiang is a woman. He just keeps attacking. His eyes and throat are all places where he attacks. In short, he attacks wherever there is fatality, making it impossible to guard against!

"Qiongxiao, you don't understand how to show mercy and pity the jade, and you are so vicious!" Lan Xiang shouted.

"Hey, senior sister, in a life and death fight, who cares about the difference between men and women? There is only a difference between life and death!" Qiong Xiao said jokingly.

"You, you, you! I'm really mad at you! This is a sparring match! Are you trying to fight to the death?"

"Okay, let's discuss and learn from each other!"

In fact, not only Lan Xiang felt uncomfortable, Qiong Xiao also complained secretly. Lan Xiang's sensitivity was really terrifying. He could almost dodge Qiong Xiao's attacks, and Lan Xiang's fighting style was also a bit rogue. Qiong Xiao's crotch, nose, eyes, and Lan Xiang were all taken care of, which made Qiong Xiao complain a lot.

After fighting for a long time, there was still no winner. Both Lan Xiang and Qiong Xiao were complaining."In that case, let's take a gamble!" Lan Xiang said secretly.

As Qiong Xiao came up with a punch, according to common sense in martial arts, there was no doubt that Lan Xiang had to dodge this punch, but Lan Xiang suddenly seemed to be petrified, without the slightest intention to dodge, he suddenly stopped, put down his resistance, and walked straight towards Qiong Xiao's fist with his small face.Qiong Xiao was startled, seeing that her fist was about to hit Lan Xiang's face. If this punch hit Lan Xiang, Lan Xiang's beautiful face would be disfigured!At the critical moment, Qiong Xiao's fist turned and passed by Lan Xiang's face.

"What a risk!" Qiong Xiao was secretly happy, and was about to ask Lan Xiang what was going on and why he stopped suddenly?But before he could say anything, he received a heavy punch in the face, and he immediately staggered back a few steps.
